title: Completed Project Health Check Matrix Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed Project Health Check Matrix artifact data payloads (PMO-06.11).

review_purpose_and_milestone_stage.description: The objective of the independent health review and the project lifecycle phase or gate at which it is conducted.

lead_reviewer_and_assessment_date.description: The independent PMO auditor or assurance lead conducting the review and the inspection date.

overall_health_rating.description: The synthesized overall health score (Red, Amber, or Green) representing aggregate delivery confidence.

governance_and_sponsorship_health.description: Health rating and findings on steering committee engagement, decision timeliness, and charter mandate.

scope_and_change_control_health.description: Health rating and findings on baseline stability, scope creep control, and change request rigor.

schedule_and_milestone_health.description: Health rating and findings on critical path adherence, milestone float, and delivery velocity.

cost_and_budget_variance_health.description: Health rating and findings on earned value metrics (CPI), cost variance, and EAC forecast credibility.

risk_and_issue_exposure_health.description: Health rating and findings on risk register currency, mitigation effectiveness, and unresolved issues.

stakeholder_and_team_health.description: Health rating and findings on team morale, resourcing levels, and stakeholder satisfaction.

critical_finding_description.description: Key vulnerability or red-flag issue identified during the health check audit.

mandated_corrective_action.description: Specific remedial intervention required to return the project domain to acceptable performance.

remediation_owner_and_due_date.description: The assigned individual accountable for corrective action execution and the strict due date.
